svg.aria-label: A synthetic-data pipeline is a funnel
svg.text: A synthetic-data pipeline is a funnel
Stub generator, no model calls: 600 candidate instructions from 12 seeds, filtered in order
from a seed or an earlier
none of the four known-bad recipes survives; copies die as duplicates
what dedup did and did not do
near-copies fell from 0.737 to 0.099 of rows,
but the kept rows share long suffixes, so mean
cosine went up, and human text is far wider
